height.storey_justification: 3.5 m is the rounded median of height/building:levels on this extract (observed median ≈ 3.57 m). roof:height is contained in height and is never added.

part_resolution.rule: Assign each building:part to the smallest parent whose outline contains the part centroid or >=50% of the part vertices. Drop the parent (keep parts) if sum(part area)/parent area >= 0.55, or if the parent has no height/levels and coverage >= 0.4. Otherwise keep the parent and drop those claimed parts. Unclaimed parts are kept. Dual-tagged building+building:part features are treated as parents.

accuracy.note: Corner error is chart distance minus WGS84 Vincenty, in centimetres. Due-north must have +X and Y≈0; due-east +Y and X≈0.

projection.description: Local tangent-plane / equirectangular chart on WGS84. north_m = (lat-lat0)*pi/180*M, east_m = (lon-lon0)*pi/180*N*cos(lat0), with M=6370889.698 m and N=6390011.309 m evaluated at the origin. Then centimetres = metres * 100. UE +X = north, +Y = east, +Z = up.
projection.name: WGS84 local tangent-plane / equirectangular

roads.class_default_justification: Curb-to-curb carriageway, not building-to-building. primary 16 m (~52 ft, 4–5 lanes: Park Ave / 42nd St); secondary 13 m (~43 ft, 3–4 lanes: 5th / 6th / Madison); residential 10 m (~33 ft, 2 lanes + parking on numbered streets); service 5 m (single-track driveway / parking aisle); pedestrian 6 m (linear pedestrian street, unused on this extract). Link ramps are one lane-group narrower than their parent class.
roads.inclusion_rule: Include linear vehicle streets and linear pedestrian streets: living_street, motorway, motorway_link, pedestrian, primary, primary_link, residential, secondary, secondary_link, service, tertiary, tertiary_link, trunk, trunk_link, unclassified. footway/path/steps/cycleway/bridleway/corridor/track and area=yes plazas are not street centrelines. Tunnels and non-zero layer ways are kept and flagged.
roads.lane_justification: 3.25 m (10.7 ft) is the midpoint of the NYC DOT 10–11 ft travel-lane range used on midtown Manhattan streets. No way in this extract has a width tag.

derived_roof_height.assumption: one storey of roof using this extract's STOREY_M=3.5 m when the file states a shape but has no roof:height / roof:levels / roof:angle and no tagged peer roof:height to take a median from

roof.height_rule: roof:height if tagged (already contained in height, never added); else roof:levels * STOREY_M (3.5 m); else tan(roof:angle) * run (half the across-span, full span for skillion); else this extract's median tagged roof:height for that shape; else median of all non-flat tagged roof:heights; else one storey (3.5 m) as an explicit assumption.
roof.ridge_rule: roof:direction is the slope high→low (rain); the ridge is perpendicular. Else roof:orientation=along/across relative to the longest footprint edge (S3DB default along). Else that longest edge.
